  • Method Details

    • composeView

      private void composeView(Game game, LinkedList<String> playerOrder)
      Constructs the CLI view starting from a Game object representing the ongoing game and a list of players that specifies the player order. The views are gathered by the ViewPrototypes enum and the placeholders are substituted with the player data.
      Parameters:
      game - The Game object defining the ongoing game
      playerOrder - a LinkedList containing the player associated to the client in the first position and the other players in the other positions

    • usernameFormatter

      private String usernameFormatter(String username, int completedObjectives)
      Formats the username to account for the correct amount of padding and adds the completed objective badges to the username of the player who reached them.
      Parameters:
      username - The username to be formatted
      completedObjectives - An integer representing which objectives were reached: 1 for objective I, 2 for objective II and 3 for both
      Returns:
      The formatted username with a badge (where applicable)

    • update

      void update(Game game, LinkedList<String> playerOrder)
      Triggers the last turn warning and calls compose view to print out the CLI view
      Specified by:
      update in class View
      Parameters:
      game - The Game object defining the ongoing game
      playerOrder - The list of players. The first spot of the list always contains the player associated to the current client.

      private int choicePrompt(String message, String[] options)
      Shows an indexed list of choices. The user can select one of the options through its index and then confirm it through a standard "y/n" prompt.

      Returns:
      The index number chosen by the user
